The '''Namaryne system''' (sometimes called '''Rydonni Prime system''') was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region located along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its only [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Rydo]], and its only habitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the corporate [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] world [[Rydonni Prime]].<ref name="AJ9" />
